nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances; written in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Public string token name 'COSTA_RICA_WINS'.
Public string token symbol 'COSWI'.
Public uint8 decimals set to 18.
Public uint256 total supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spending allowances; written in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Constructor-like function that assigns the entire totalSupply to msg.sender.
Public transfer: requires sender balance >= value, then debits sender and credits recipient.
Public approve: sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value without any validation.
Public transferFrom: checks balance and allowance, then moves tokens and decrements the allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance key in the constructor, transfer, approve and transferFrom.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer; arithmetic state mutation driven by user input.
balanceOf[to] += value in transfer; arithmetic state mutation credited to a user supplied address.
balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom; arithmetic debit of a user supplied address.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom; arithmetic allowance decrement.
balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom; arithmetic credit to a user supplied address.
address to parameter of transfer, the credit target of the token amount.
uint256 value parameter of transfer, the amount deducted and credited.
address spender parameter of approve, the approved spender.
uint256 value parameter of approve, the allowance amount granted.
address from parameter of transferFrom, the debited owner.
address to parameter of transferFrom, the credited recipient.
uint256 value parameter of transferFrom, the amount moved and removed from allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key that receives the entire totalSupply in the constructor.
totalSupply is assigned into balanceOf[msg.sender] in the constructor.
The constructor writes the balanceOf mapping.
transfer reads balanceOf[msg.sender], so the caller address flows into the function.
The unsafe subtraction mutates balanceOf[msg.sender].
The user supplied value is subtracted from the caller balance without safe math.
transfer executes the unchecked balance subtraction.
The unsafe addition mutates balanceOf[to].
The user supplied destination address indexes the balance credit.
transfer executes the unchecked balance addition.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][...], so the caller address flows into the function.
The spender parameter becomes the inner key of the allowance mapping.
The value parameter is stored as the allowance amount.
approve writes the allowance mapping without validation.
transferFrom uses the from parameter as the debited owner key.
transferFrom uses the to parameter as the credited recipient key.
transferFrom uses the value parameter as the amount to move.
The from address indexes the unchecked debit of balanceOf[from].
The value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[from] without safe math.
The unchecked subtraction mutates balanceOf[from].
transferFrom executes the unchecked balance debit.
The value parameter is subtracted from the nested allowance mapping without safe math.
msg.sender indexes the spender slot of the allowance being decremented.
The unchecked subtraction mutates allowance[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance decrement.
The to address indexes the unchecked credit of balanceOf[to].
The value parameter is added to balanceOf[to] without safe math.
The unchecked addition mutates balanceOf[to].
transferFrom executes the unchecked balance credit.
transferFrom relies on msg.sender as the allowance spender, keying authorization on the caller identity.
